text_block_list.text:
One day, after reaching a major
milestone in my time with <chrname>.
Invited by Ms. Tazuna, I came along to watch the races at the track, but—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Traineeer!
Over here, over here!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: It's not even meeting time yet, but you're already here!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, absolutely!
I just couldn't wait any longer.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Well then—shall we get going right away!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Whew, today was even livelier than usual!
As expected of a GⅠ race day...!
choice_data_list: The excitement in the venue was incredible, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely!
The cheering was so thunderous the ground itself shook!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This thrill, this emotionâ
races truly are magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much
for joining me today.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I just felt I absolutely had to thank you again
in person, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Over these past three years, alongside <chrname>,
you've run through so many races together, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I watched it all. In person, on TV...
My heart was racing seeing you all achieve so much.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You truly showed us so many miraculous, dreamlike moments.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So, once more.
...Thank you for touching my heart, !

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And... please continue running toward the future
safely and without any injuries!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: A lovely response♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll be sure to keep a close eye on
your future endeavors as well.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Just a little bit closer to you than before♪

Together with <chrname>, who joined us later,
we enjoyed watching the race alongside Tazuna-san.
